42:def compile_import_statement(fields: list[ImportVar]) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
43:    """Compile an import statement.
44:
45:    Args:
46:        fields: The set of fields to import from the library.
47:
48:    Raises:
49:        ValueError: If there is more than one default import.
50:
51:    Returns:
52:        The libraries for default and rest.
53:        default: default library. When install "import def from library".
54:        rest: rest of libraries. When install "import {rest1, rest2} from library"
55:    """
56:    # ignore the ImportVar fields with render=False during compilation
57:    fields_set = {field for field in fields if field.render}
58:
59:    # Check for default imports.
60:    defaults = {field for field in fields_set if field.is_default}
61:    if len(defaults) >= 2:
62:        raise ValueError("Only one default import is allowed.")
63:
64:    # Get the default import, and the specific imports.
65:    default = next(iter({field.name for field in defaults}), "")
66:    rest = {field.name for field in fields_set - defaults}
67:
68:    return default, list(rest)
